deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 39 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Serial Number\""

original_test_intent: Validate each Type 39 Serial Number against the approved PSU/FRU identity while preserving string-reference integrity and authorized privacy handling across reboot.
original_method: Resolve each raw Serial Number string index, bind the protected value or authorized redaction to a stable supply identity, compare with read-only inventory under one evidence policy and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies protected serial baselines/policy and approves reboot; no physical supply action is part of the core test.
required_inputs: Expected serial-to-supply/FRU mapping or approved comparison service
Access-control, redaction, retention and display policy
Allowed blank/unknown formats and duplicate policy
SMBIOS parser, read-only inventory and approved reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Treat serial numbers as controlled identity evidence; do not expose them in unrestricted summaries.
Validate the raw string index before redaction and use the same protected comparison policy pre/post.
Never remove, swap or power-cycle a PSU to confirm a serial.
Stop on power/management failure and do not auto-retry reboot.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve and validate every Serial Number reference, perform protected identity comparison, record only authorized representations and diff identity-bound results across reboot.
Flag dangling, blank, duplicate, mismatched, unexpectedly redacted or drifting values without issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve serial baseline, privacy/redaction policy and reboot plan.
Review protected discrepancies and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field label is relevant, but grep loses raw index/record ownership and can disclose serials without a handling policy.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive protected raw/decoded Type 39 under access control; emit stable supply ID, string-index validity, authorized serial representation, inventory match and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Serial Number scope, Type 39 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; evidence access controls are added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate every serial string reference, compare exact values within an approved protected boundary, expose only authorized redactions/hashes, and repeat with stable PSU identity after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 39 Serial Number string definition plus organizational identity-data policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds string integrity, supply binding and controlled evidence handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects wrong or changing serials without leaking raw identity data into general logs.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Protected serial source and evidence policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Hashes are useful for stability but do not prove correctness unless compared within the authoritative protected mapping.

project_override_considerations: Projects may redact or hash serials, but must retain an authorized exact comparison path and cannot count merely non-empty/redacted text as correctness.
expected_evidence: Approved serial mapping and privacy/redaction policy
Protected pre-reboot Type 39 handles, raw index validation and authorized serial representation
Per-supply protected inventory comparison and blank/duplicate decisions
Statement that no PSU was manipulated
Approved reboot/health record and protected post-reboot diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Serial Number is a valid Type 39 string field; privacy and expected identity are execution inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Protected string validation and inventory comparison are fully automatable when approved data controls are supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds protected evidence, raw reference integrity and stable identity binding.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains privacy/safety scope while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates unavailable protected inputs from automation classification and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents both serial leakage and false validation of a serial that belongs to a different supply or an invalid string reference.
independent_technical_reasoning: Serial correctness is an exact identity relation; it must be evaluated in a protected context against a stable PSU/FRU mapping, not by visual inspection of arbitrary text.
